subject.title: Prefer chat names in agent session labels

question: Should Descriptive-mode Codex agent sessions prioritize the originating chat name and append task context, rather than preserve the task-first labels introduced by the prior feature?
rationale: This is an intentional user-visible preference change within an existing setting, so source inspection and tests cannot determine the repository's desired label semantics.

options.title: Adopt chat-first labels
options.body: Accept the visible Descriptive-mode label change because it keeps task context while making otherwise-collapsed chats distinguishable.

options.title: Keep task-first labels
options.body: Decline this follow-up to preserve the recently merged task and guardian labels for existing Descriptive-mode users.

recommendation.title: Adopt chat-first labels
recommendation.body: Accept the visible Descriptive-mode label change because it keeps task context while making otherwise-collapsed chats distinguishable.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged descriptive-label implementation and have the strongest concrete history on the affected formatter behavior.
